title: Stochastic Perturbation of 36-Layer Quarter-Wave Initialization
scientific_hypothesis: Breaking the periodic initialization bias by applying ±12 nm stochastic offsets to quarter-wave thickness targets will enable the optimizer to escape local minima and discover non-repetitive interference regimes that improve dual-stopband suppression without degrading passband transmission.
design_principle: Modified quarter-wavelength optimization with randomized phase shifts between adjacent layer pairs to sample diverse constructive/destructive interference configurations.
proposed_topology: 36 finite layers with alternating Ta2O5/SiO2 sequence starting with Ta2O5 at air interface, terminated on fused silica substrate. Exact layer count: 36 layers (18 Ta2O5 + 18 SiO2 pairs).
design_variables: initialization offsets (±12 nm from quarter-wave targets at 550 nm)
manufacturing_considerations: all thicknesses within 20-350 nm fabrication bounds
alternating sequence compatible with standard deposition
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack theory for high-reflection bands
Perturbation theory for escaping local optimization minima
expected_advantages: Escapes numerical convergence issues from route_02
Samples broader design space than periodic initialization
known_risks: Random initialization may require more optimization iterations
No guarantee of improvement over route_02 best score
execution_request_english: Optimize a 36-layer Ta2O5/SiO2 alternating stack on fused silica substrate at 0 deg incidence, unpolarized. Initialize with quarter-wave optical thicknesses at 550 nm reference wavelength, then apply independent random offsets of ±12 nm to each layer before optimization. Bounds: 20-350 nm per layer. Optimize all 36 thicknesses to maximize average transmittance in 420-700 nm passband while minimizing average transmittance in 355-365 nm and 1030-1080 nm stopbands, and minimizing transmittance at 355 nm. Report best_target_score, valid_candidates count, tightest_margin, and final thicknesses_nm array for all candidates. Canonical user controls: incidence angles 0 degrees. polarization unpolarized. wavelength intervals 355-355 nm, 355-365 nm, 420-700 nm, 1030-1080 nm. soft objectives: high average transmittance in 420-700 nm; low average transmittance at 355 nm; low average transmittance in 355-365 nm; low average transmittance in 1030-1080 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high transmittance at 355 nm; high transmittance in 355-365 nm; high transmittance in 1030-1080 nm; high loss in 420-700 nm. manufacturing constraints: maximum 36 layers; layer thickness range 20-350 nm.
revision_reason: Applied insight appendage guidance to break periodic initialization bias from route_02 by introducing ±12 nm stochastic offsets to quarter-wave targets, addressing numerical_convergence failure category observed in prior iteration.
